# School morning birdsong

* Recording: Birds forest.ogg, by Wikimedia Commons user Barracuda1983.
* Source and license declaration: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Birds_forest.ogg
* Direct original: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/38/Birds_forest.ogg
* License: the copyright holder releases the recording into the public domain worldwide; where that is not legally possible the holder grants unrestricted use (Wikimedia Commons PD-self).
* The original recording is stereo Ogg Vorbis, 44,100 Hz, approximately 14.65 seconds.
* SHA-256: 60d77abf548030e85abec22053a6392df91320718e26b93180f562b1bf7989ac.
* Birds_forest.ogg is the original file; Assets/Resources/SchoolMorning/birds.ogg is a byte-identical copy. Copy the original to that path to reproduce the Unity asset.
* The game does not alter the recording. Its school ending applies a four-second fade-in, lowers the old room ambience, and fades out before the result screen.
